quests.instruction: Which letter is next in line after E?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song up to E. What letter comes next?
quests.explanation: F comes right after E. In the alphabet: E, F, G.
quests.funFact: The word 'of' ends with f, but we say it with a 'vvv' sound.

quests.instruction: What comes after T?
quests.hint: Say the letters in order from the start until you pass the one you need.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say T, U, V, so U is the one after T.
quests.funFact: Many children learn the alphabet order with a song, because a tune makes a long list easier to remember.

quests.instruction: What letter comes just before B?
quests.hint: B is near the start of the alphabet.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say A, B, so A is the one before B.
quests.funFact: A to M is the first half of the alphabet, and N to Z is the second half.

quests.instruction: Which letter do you sing right before Y?
quests.hint: Say the letters in order and notice which one comes right ahead.
quests.explanation: X comes right before Y. In the alphabet: W, X, Y.
quests.funFact: X rarely begins English words; many X words begin with a 'zzz' sound, like xylophone.

quests.instruction: Sing the alphabet: ... h, then what? Which letter is next?
quests.hint: The letter after h comes just before j.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say h, i, j, so i is the one after h.
quests.funFact: The little dot on a lowercase i is called a tittle.

quests.instruction: Which letter is earliest in the alphabet: T, X or M?
quests.hint: Think of A at the start and Z at the end. Which letter is closest to that end?
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go M, T, X, so M comes first.
quests.funFact: When two words begin with the same letter, we look at the second letter to decide which comes first.

quests.instruction: Which comes first in the alphabet: o, t or c?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and see which of these letters you reach first.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go c, o, t, so c comes first.
quests.funFact: Five of the 26 letters are vowels: a, e, i, o and u. The other 21 are consonants.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes right after f in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Say the letters in order from the start until you pass the one you need.
quests.explanation: g comes right after f. In the alphabet: f, g, h.
quests.funFact: A computer keyboard is not in alphabet order. Its top row starts with Q, W, E, R, T, Y.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes right before G in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop just before G. Which letter did you sing last?
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say E, F, G, so F is the one before G.
quests.funFact: You can stretch out the 'fff' sound, like air slowly leaving a balloon.

quests.instruction: Which letter fits in the middle: U, __, W?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song slowly and listen for the gap.
quests.explanation: The order is U, V, W.
quests.funFact: Vest, vase and vine all begin with V.

quests.instruction: Which letter is next in line after p?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song up to p. What letter comes next?
quests.explanation: q comes right after p. In the alphabet: p, q, r.
quests.funFact: Q is one of the least common letters in English words.

quests.instruction: Sing the alphabet. Which do you sing last: H, U or L?
quests.hint: Think of A at the start and Z at the end. Which letter is closest to that end?
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go H, L, U, so U comes last.
quests.funFact: Z is the last letter. In some countries it is called 'zed'.

quests.instruction: Which letter comes right before F in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop just before F. Which letter did you sing last?
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say D, E, F, so E is the one before F.
quests.funFact: The word alphabet comes from alpha and beta, the first two letters of the Greek alphabet.

quests.instruction: Which letter belongs between S and U?
quests.hint: Say the alphabet from S. The next letter before U is the one.
quests.explanation: T sits between S and U.
quests.funFact: The English alphabet has 26 letters, and they always come in the same order.

quests.instruction: One letter is hiding. Which one? u, v, w, __
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song quietly and stop at the gap.
quests.explanation: x completes the line: u, v, w, x.
quests.funFact: X marks the spot on a treasure map.

quests.instruction: Which letter is missing? T, U, __, W
quests.hint: Say the letters in order, starting at T. Which letter is needed at the blank?
quests.explanation: The full line is T, U, V, W, so the missing letter is V.
quests.funFact: If you know what comes before and after a letter, you can find words in a dictionary faster.

quests.instruction: Sing the alphabet: ... X, then what? Which letter is next?
quests.hint: The letter after X comes just before Z.
quests.explanation: Y comes right after X. In the alphabet: X, Y, Z.
quests.funFact: Y is sometimes called 'the sometimes vowel'.

quests.instruction: What letter sits between J and L in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Think: after J comes what? Then check it comes before L.
quests.explanation: K sits between J and L.
quests.funFact: K is letter number 11 of the 26 letters, with 10 letters before it and 15 after it.

quests.instruction: Sing the alphabet. Which do you sing last: b, x or g?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and see which of these letters you reach last.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go b, g, x, so x comes last.
quests.funFact: In math, x often stands for a number we do not know yet.

quests.instruction: Complete the line: q, r, s, __
quests.hint: The blank is letter number 4 in a line of 4. Say the line from the start and stop there.
quests.explanation: t completes the line: q, r, s, t.
quests.funFact: Dictionaries, phone contact lists and library shelves all use alphabet order.

quests.instruction: Which letter do you sing right before q?
quests.hint: The letter before q comes just after o.
quests.explanation: p comes right before q. In the alphabet: o, p, q.
quests.funFact: A to Z has 26 letters, so every letter has exactly one place in line.

quests.instruction: What letter sits between Q and S in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Think: after Q comes what? Then check it comes before S.
quests.explanation: The order is Q, R, S.
quests.funFact: Class lists are often sorted in alphabet order by the first letter of each name.

quests.instruction: What letter goes in the blank? N, O, P, __
quests.hint: Look at the letter before the blank, P. What comes after it?
quests.explanation: The full line is N, O, P, Q, so the missing letter is Q.
quests.funFact: Lowercase q has a round tummy on the left and a stick hanging below the line.

quests.instruction: Which line shows these 3 capital letters in the right order, A to Z?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song. In which row do the letters come in the same order?
quests.explanation: O, Q, T is in alphabet order: each letter comes after the one before it.
quests.funFact: O is a vowel. It can say 'oh' as in go, or a short sound as in octopus.

quests.instruction: Fill the gap in the alphabet line: F, G, __, I
quests.hint: The blank is letter number 3 in a line of 4. Say the line from the start and stop there.
quests.explanation: The full line is F, G, H, I, so the missing letter is H.
quests.funFact: Say 'huh' with your hand in front of your mouth and you can feel warm air.

quests.instruction: Sing the alphabet. Which do you sing first: x, q or h?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and see which of these letters you reach first.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order these go h, q, x, so h comes first.
quests.funFact: In hour and honest, the h is silent.

quests.instruction: What letter comes just before T?
quests.hint: Say the letters in order and notice which one comes right ahead.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order you say R, S, T, so S is the one before T.
quests.funFact: Sun, star and snake all begin with S.

quests.instruction: Pick the small-letter row that is in alphabet order (3 letters).
quests.hint: Check each row: does every letter come after the one before it?
quests.explanation: a, c, e is in alphabet order: each letter comes after the one before it.
quests.funFact: A is the first letter of the alphabet, and it is a vowel.

quests.instruction: Which letter fits in the middle: v, __, x?
quests.hint: Say the alphabet from v. The next letter before x is the one.
quests.explanation: The order is v, w, x.
quests.funFact: Web addresses often start with www, which stands for World Wide Web.

quests.instruction: Fill the gap in the alphabet line: t, u, v, __, x
quests.hint: Say the letters in order, starting at t. Which letter is needed at the blank?
quests.explanation: w completes the line: t, u, v, w, x.
quests.funFact: In two and answer, the w is silent.
